title: Fleer 87 #8 Wade Boggs Boston Red Sox Baseball Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This is a vintage 1988 Fleer 87 trading card featuring Wade Boggs, a former Major League Baseball player for the Boston Red Sox. The card measures 3½" x 2½" and is an original, not a licensed reprint. It is part of the Sports Trading Card category and is a Trading Card Single.

The card is serial numbered and has the card number 8, representing Boggs' number 87. It is a great addition to any baseball fan's collection and is a must-have for Boston Red Sox enthusiasts. Get your hands on this piece of baseball history today!
